objective: Turn the production-verified EVA acquisition runner into a quality-aware expert-intelligence capability: classify epistemic value at ingestion time, learn what a source has declared it cannot know, route each question to where it can actually be answered, and deposit the single-source-interrogation pattern into the Power Pack baseline.
constraints: Reuse the deep-research epistemic engine; never fork cap_epistemic or the epistemic ladder
Derived judgment runs after raw is durable and can never cost a capture
A stored verdict must be reproducible from raw alone
EVA is a source, never a source of truth; nothing here auto-promotes a vendor answer
No access control is bypassed; a login wall pauses durably and asks for a human
A lens with fewer than three observed answers may RANK a prompt but may never DIVERT it away from the source (HR-ACTION-VERDICT-NEEDS-CLASS-LOCAL-EVIDENCE-001)

answered_this_arc.question: Whether the remaining prompts contain enough non-case-data questions to be worth the run, given 14 of 38 assessed already route to a human expert
answered_this_arc.answer: YES, and the framing was wrong. Routing 2,147 pending: 1,738 EVA_HIGH_VALUE, 409 MULTI_SOURCE, 0 diverted. The case-data lens -- the one expected to be dead weight -- returned 4/4 extractable at 7,225 chars average, the richest in the corpus. Expert-routing and answer-richness are independent, and only one of them is a reason to stop asking.
answered_this_arc.method: 15-prompt calibration probe, 3 topics x 5 templates (the corpus's own crossing used as a free controlled experiment)

answered_this_arc.question: Can expert-routing volume be estimated from the corpus before spending a single prompt?
answered_this_arc.answer: YES -- the estimate was correct (4/4 REAL_CASES routed to an expert, exactly as predicted). But the ACTION derived from it (stop asking that lens) was wrong. A correct prediction does not validate the action attached to it; the action carries its own premise and needs its own measurement (T-RIGHT-PREDICTION-WRONG-ACTION-001).

answered_this_arc.question: Whether cohort-claim density stays near the observed 21% across families outside 00B/00C/00D
answered_this_arc.answer: NO. The 37% measured on the early slice was a fact about that slice, not the corpus -- earliest items are the ones written first and are systematically unlike the rest. Real remainder reads 19.1%, and concentrated in a single template rather than spread (T-RATE-EXTRAPOLATED-FROM-THE-UNREPRESENTATIVE-SLICE-001).

answered_this_arc.question: Is the pending corpus N independent items?
answered_this_arc.answer: NO -- it is a generator. 1,995 prompts resolve to 399 topics x 5 templates with zero unmatched rows, collapsing the routing decision space from ~2,000 judgments to 5. Cost to discover: one prefix/suffix clustering query.
